changelog: Shared craft-common base: new optional argBase64Keys, jsonTextKeys and previewTools options (for DesignCraft); no change in this plugin's tools.
name: WordCraft
description: Headless word processor (WordCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust). Writes and edits documents with styles, headings, tables, lists, track changes, comments and mail merge; opens DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML, plain text and TeX; saves DOCX, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML and plain text and exports PDF and PNG page previews.
instructions:
WordCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Upload the user's file to /work and open it: open_document {"path":"/work/notes.md"} reads .docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf, .md, .html, .txt and .tex; Markdown headings and tables become Heading N styles and real tables. Or start empty with new_document {"template":"blank"}.
2. Write with type_text {"text":"...","paragraphs":true} and execute {"command":"text.newParagraph"}; move the caret with execute {"command":"caret.docEnd"}. Make the current paragraph a heading with execute {"command":"para.style","params":{"style":"Heading 1"}} (or para.heading1). Insert a table at the caret with insert_table {"values":[["Region","Revenue"],["North","120"]],"header":true}.
3. Everything else (lists, fonts, page setup, track changes, comments, mail merge…) is an engine command: list_commands {"query":"table"} — always pass a query, never list all — then execute {"command":...,"params":{...}}, or batch for several commands at once.
4. Check the result: inspect_document shows the blocks with their styles and tables, get_text the plain text; render_page {"page":1} saves a PNG of the page into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it.
5. Save always with a path in /work, the format follows the extension: save_document {"path":"/work/report.docx"}, then save_document {"path":"/work/report.pdf"}; the same with .odt, .rtf, .md or .html. Use new file names, never overwrite the user's input.
6. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. Any text argument that starts with / or ../ (also in type_text and insert_table) is checked as a file path and refused when it points outside /work, so rephrase such text (e.g. "etc folder" instead of "/etc"). A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with no open document, so save a .docx after each stage and reopen it then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.
